purpose: Single Source of Truth for the canonical CYNIC repository path. Every hardcoded path in scripts, docs, and tests must reference this registry.

precedence: 2. Environment variable CYNIC_REPO_ROOT (overrides for non-canonical checkouts)

expansions.${CYNIC_REPO_ROOT}: Canonical path from this registry, or CYNIC_REPO_ROOT env var
expansions.${GIT_WORKING_TREE}: Current git working tree root (resolved by finding infra/registry.json ancestor)

anti_rules: No hardcoded absolute path to the CYNIC repository outside this registry
No hardcoded path to the parent directory (asdf-forge/zeyxx) — always append /CYNIC
No hardcoded path in scripts, docs, or tests that duplicates the canonical_path value

external_projects.tier_model: serving_tier is the SSOT of the checkout root: 'served' -> production_root (service-owned, sudo-managed), 'dev' -> development_root (user-owned). roots.referential in infra/external-project-registry.json MUST equal f(serving_tier). CLI 'cynic external promote' migrates a project between tiers cleanly.
external_projects.canonical_clone_rule: One canonical clone per project slug, under the root determined by serving_tier. Clones live outside the CYNIC repository tree (no nested .git). Never duplicate a clone across roots.

coherence_contract.description: Verifies every consumer carries the canonical path from this registry, and no unregistered hardcoded path exists.
